design_rationale: The v1 protocol used three neurons and two explicitly fixed feed-forward synapses, so dimensional coordinates barely affected the causal transfer mechanism. V2 makes topology causal by constructing matched-size directed graphs from geometry while holding node count, edge-count schedule, synaptic weight, delay, stimulus, neuron model and evaluation window fixed.

matched_budgets.edge_count_rule: sum_i min(4, N-i-1), identical for all conditions

topology_mechanism.rank_constraint: edges are directed from lower canonical label to higher canonical label to keep the small-network propagation test acyclic and prevent recurrence from confounding Stage 1
topology_mechanism.geometric_conditions: for each source label, connect to the nearest future labels under normalized Euclidean distance; seed is used only to break exact distance ties deterministically
topology_mechanism.5d_shuffled: shuffle the 5D coordinate-to-label assignment before geometric edge construction while keeping labels, node count, edge-count schedule, weights, delays and stimulus fixed
topology_mechanism.random_graph: sample future targets uniformly without replacement with the identical out-degree schedule

calibration.purpose: activity adequacy only; not a hypothesis test
calibration.selection_rule: choose the lowest candidate weight for which every condition has median active_fraction >= 0.25, median output_reach_fraction >= 0.25, and median delivered_events >= 32

evaluation.test: exact two-sided paired sign test on non-zero differences
evaluation.multiple_testing: Holm correction across all primary endpoint/contrast tests
evaluation.effect_interval: deterministic paired bootstrap 95% CI for the median difference, 5000 resamples

activity_adequacy_gate.status_rule: PASS only when the preregistered calibration selection rule yields a weight; otherwise evaluation is not executed and the hypothesis remains NOT_TESTED

decision_rule.supported_within_protocol: activity gate PASS and at least one preregistered primary contrast/end-point has Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 and bootstrap CI excluding zero
decision_rule.no_detected_difference: activity gate PASS but the supported_within_protocol rule is not met
decision_rule.not_tested: activity gate FAIL or an execution/integrity error occurs

claim_boundary: This protocol tests RQ-SNN-003/H-SNN-003-B for a 64-neuron Stage-1 topology-sensitive propagation regime. It is not evidence for RQ-5D-005/H-5D-005-A, does not test a 5D advantage, does not establish scaling, cognition, biological equivalence or independent replication, and creates DATA rather than EVID.
